info.name: Session Management
info.description:
## RefreshTokens

Unified session-management endpoints shared by all roles. The role is embedded in the opaque token's DB record — the client uses the same URLs whether the principal is admin or user.

### Base URL
`{{base_url}}/api/v1`

### Authentication
No bearer header is required: the opaque refresh token is sent in the request body and authenticates the call by itself.

### Environment Variables
| Variable | Description |
|---|---|
| `base_url` | API base URL |
| `admin_refresh_token` | Admin refresh token (auto-set on login) |
| `admin_access_token` | Admin JWT (auto-set on refresh) |
| `user_refresh_token` | User refresh token (auto-set on OTP verify) |
| `user_access_token` | User JWT (auto-set on refresh) |
| `active_role` | Role used by Logout to clear the right token pair (set this to `admin` or `user` before calling Logout). |

request.description:
### Auth
None — the refresh token itself authenticates the call.

### Input
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| refreshToken | string | YES | The opaque refresh token issued on login. |

### Notes
Rotates the presented refresh token atomically: the old row is revoked and a new one is issued in the same transaction. Reusing an already-rotated token revokes every active session for the principal (suspected theft). The test script updates `<role>_access_token` and `<role>_refresh_token` for the role embedded in the response.

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | Token missing, expired, revoked, or reused after rotation |
| 422 | Validation failed |
| 429 | Auth throttle exceeded |

### Auth
None — the refresh token itself authenticates the call.

### Input
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| refreshToken | string | YES | The opaque refresh token to revoke. |

### Notes
Idempotent: revoking an unknown or already-revoked token returns success. Set the environment variable `active_role` (`admin` or `user`) before calling so the test script clears the right token pair.

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 422 | Validation failed |
| 429 | Auth throttle exceeded |
